craft_notes: Sthāyin: liṅga-pūjā unit 23. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In suitable and in tūra loss would be, in its deficient sacrifice supr
eme; desired indeed would-be-tūra — thus some adopted.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yukte ca tūre hāniḥ syāt taddhīne yāga uttamaḥ kāmya eva bhavettūramiti kecitprapedire
